profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer at ServiceNow
profile.summary: Experienced Software Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Strong experience working with C, C++, C#, and many other languages, quick and eager to learn new ones.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Obtaining this position during the pandemic was definitely a miracle. ServiceNow and the teams that worked with me in making sure I was able to work from home were simply incredible. I was able to do the whole internship remotely with teams in the U.S. I loved every bit of it and gained a ton of experience building different components that touched many parts of their system.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: My time in the bay area working for interior design company Houzz was an incredible experience. I gained immeasurable amounts of new knowledge and appreciation for the modern development process. While interning there, I developed and maintained a new feature that touched all ends of Houzz’s development platform, which was pushed live for millions of consumers.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Developing and updating Ctrl V's booking software web app, to make it simpler and more user-friendly for both consumers and franchisees.

honors.title: The Most Wanted to See Finished
honors.description: In a group of four, we made a 2D platformer game in forty-eight hours in C# using Unity game engine. The game was called Dueality, depicting a man who could change into different frequencies of waves. We all learned a lot about how to work well in a team, as well as the size and scale of a game we can create in a limited amount of time. We earned "The Most Wanted to See Finished" award at the end of the Game Jam.
honors.issuer: Issued by Global Game Jam 2017 · Jan 2017

honors.title: Ontario Scholar
honors.description: Awarded an Ontario Scholar, which are high-school graduates in Ontario who achieve a total average of 80% and above in their six best Grade 12 courses.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Waterloo · Jan 2016
